text: 10月9日早盘，市场集体下挫，创业板指跌破3000点。盘中，华夏科创50ETF、易方达创业板ETF、南方中证1000ETF、华泰柏瑞沪深300ETF等核心宽基ETF显著放量。一批市场核心宽基ETF交投显著放大。值得注意的是，南方中证1000ETF、南方中证500ETF等多只中小盘宽基ETF半日成交额已超过昨日全天成交量，机构资金的博弈在早盘就已经展开。（中国基金报）
text_en: On the morning of October 9, the market fell collectively, with the ChiNext Index dropping below 3000 points. Intraday, core broad-based ETFs such as ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF, E Fund ChiNext ETF, China Southern CSI 1000 ETF and Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF saw significant volume increases. A group of core broad-based ETFs saw markedly enlarged trading activity. Notably, several small- and mid-cap broad-based ETFs such as China Southern CSI 1000 ETF and China Southern CSI 500 ETF had half-day turnover already exceeding yesterday's full-day volume, with institutional capital games already unfolding in the morning session. (China Fund News)
